title: Criteria in Evaluation of Requests for Road Safety Features around Schools and Residential Areas and Follow-up Reviews
what_it_is: Criteria in Evaluation of Requests for Road Safety Features around Schools and Residential Areas and Follow-up Reviews

sections.label: LTA road safety feedback assessment
sections.summary: LTA receives road safety requests from MPs and the public, and assesses each by reviewing pedestrian volumes, vehicle speeds, visibility and connectivity.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) receives requests for road safety features from Members of Parliament (MP) through MP appeals, and from members of public through various channels, such as the One Service mobile application, emails and letters.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: LTA assesses every feedback received by conducting a technical assessment on the relevant stretch of road.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: For example, LTA reviews the pedestrian volumes, speed of vehicles, visibility for drivers and, more broadly, connectivity to key amenities and transport nodes, and the demographic profile of residents and stakeholders in the vicinity.

sections.label: Road safety around schools and homes
sections.summary: LTA prioritises road safety features around schools and residential areas, implements Silver Zones, and re-evaluates requests after traffic changes or accidents.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Reviewing and implementing road safety features around schools and residential areas is one of LTA’s key priorities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: For residential areas, in particular, areas with a higher proportion of seniors, LTA has implemented Silver Zones.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: LTA monitors and re-evaluates requests for road safety measures to be put in place when there are material changes to the traffic and pedestrian volumes in the area, as well as when there are accidents involved.

sections.label: More resources for road safety
sections.summary: LTA will commit more resources to road infrastructure for road safety, with about 1,000 road safety enhancement measures introduced annually islandwide.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As I have said earlier, we will continue to prioritise improving road safety and, indeed, we will be committing more resources to improving road infrastructure that will help to enhance road safety.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In fact, presently, annually, about 1,000 road safety enhancement measures are introduced islandwide.
